pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: pipeline/vlm-probe/guard.py:223 start_comfy interpolates environment-derived paths into executable PowerShell without checked quoting or a written invariant establishing that the interpolation is valid.

techniques.evidence: pipeline/probes/liveness-ab.mjs:42 Resetting the activity deadline on arriving bytes is the supervision policy itself; removing concurrency would require recreating its event coordination.
pipeline/lint-ratchet.mjs:98 The surrounding explicit loop builds error diagnostics and per-rule warning counts through different branches, matching the multiple-output rule.
pipeline/vlm-probe/identity.py:263 The verdict decision consumes supplied distances and scale values and returns text without loading models, reading files, waiting, or consulting a clock.
pipeline/vlm-probe/guard.py:49 The installation location has one declaration; consistency, motion and checkpoint fetching derive their paths from it, localizing installation changes.
pipeline/vlm-probe/guard.py:223 The PowerShell text embeds COMFY_DIR directly inside quotes; the surrounding code neither escapes it nor states an invariant excluding characters that alter that text.

pipeline/vlm-probe/consistency.py:200 The generation boundary returns a saved output path while hiding submission, polling, liveness detection and timeout handling; this wrapper supplies the probe's host and output configuration.

pipeline/probes/liveness-ab.mjs:49 Both supervision policies run through one harness against the same child cases and measurement fields; the file explicitly limits its claim to an imitation of the product policy.

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: app/library/assetMeta.ts:83 readAssetFacts asserts complete PromotedMeta after checking only two string identifiers, allowing its typed output to expose unvalidated block, cost and provenance values.

techniques.evidence: lib/assets.ts:769 Folder renaming filters assets and maps them into one rename-plan collection; persistence remains outside that transformation.
lib/assets.ts:465 Hydration receives already-created URLs and returns transformed rows; object-URL allocation and its lifetime remain the caller's responsibility.
lib/themes.ts:136 One styleFits predicate supplies the discipline rule to both the atelier and preset rail, localizing changes to that shared decision.

app/library/assetMeta.ts:83 isPromoted checks only themeId and proofId, while this assertion also promises block, provenance, promotedAt and other fields without validating them or stating an invariant establishing their shapes.
lib/assets.ts:420 Callers supply asset/blob pairs; the boundary hides database opening, both-store transaction handling and connection cleanup while preventing a partial upload commit.
